title: MNBL world activation receipt
description: Written only by U03, after the runtime validations W02-W05 and C07 pass for one campaign instance. It lives outside the immutable world data bundle (a bundle that contains a receipt fails validation) and binds that bundle's worldContentId and manifest to one campaignInstanceId, so identical world content can back separate saves without changing worldContentId. The compiler never writes it (MMR-29 defines the contract only). Resolved game-policy slots and engine caches are named by runtimeDerivedBundleSha256 and never rewrite the data bundle.

validations.description: every runtime validation the activation needs, each passed with the hash of its evidence
